summary.text: Jackie Davidson is the Republican candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 16A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Megan Woller. She has been the Republican nominee for a District 16B seat in three earlier elections.

paragraphs.text: Jackie Davidson said in a 2022 Ballotpedia survey that she has lived in Idaho for 42 years, has three adult children and has owned two businesses.
She said she owns Data Technologies Group, which supports business accounting software, and holds a degree in IT-web development.
She also said she had worked for the Republican Party for two years, including leading a get-out-the-vote effort and placing 27 precinct committee candidates on the ballot.
In that survey she listed the U.S. and Idaho constitutions, election integrity, lower taxes and education accountability among her priorities.
Davidson was the Republican nominee for Idaho House District 16B in 2020, 2022 and 2024, losing the general election to Colin Nash in 2020 and 2022 and to Todd Achilles in 2024.
She advanced unopposed from the Republican primary for District 16A on May 19, 2026.
